Accommodation for your construction crews in the Paris region

Workers posted far from home must be housed properly, near the site, on time. We take this on so your site managers can stay on site.

What we do for construction companies

A well-housed, well-rested crew means fewer absences, less turnover and a site that keeps moving.

Grouped accommodation near the site
Shared apartments, residences or hotels in the same area, with short journeys to the site.
Decent, compliant housing
Clean, heated, with kitchen and bathroom facilities: we check that conditions meet French employer obligations for workers away from home.
Transport to the site
Shuttle, vehicles or travel passes, depending on the crew's hours and site access.
Crew rotations
Arrivals, departures, replacements: we track team movements for the whole duration of the project.
Clear invoicing
One quote per project or period, and clear invoices for your travel and subsistence accounting.

Posting crews to France: what to know

Under French rules, a worker whose site is too far to return home each night is on "grand déplacement". The employer must then make sure the worker has proper accommodation: clean, heated, ventilated, with shower, washbasin and toilet. Companies posting workers from other EU countries face equivalent obligations. We know these requirements and select accommodation accordingly. Check the exact conditions in the applicable collective agreement or with your advisers.

Questions from construction companies

Can you house twenty people at once?

Yes, this is exactly the kind of request we handle for construction. The earlier you tell us, the more choice we have. We house crews in the same area with equivalent commutes to the site.

What if the project is delayed?

We extend the accommodation or arrange a follow-on solution. You tell us, we handle it.

Sending people to Paris? Call us.

In ten minutes we will understand your needs and tell you what we can do. In English or French, no commitment.
